name: the archive.org switch is ignored
why: sa_enable_internetarchive off must leave the site's page untouched (CLAUDE.md: each site's own switch).

name: the search is asked in the site's order, not by date
why: vzell's answer Q4: first by date, whatever the page sorts by.

name: an item with two dates shows its first, not the one it is ordered by
why: The Date column must agree with the order (a 1975 item dated 1975-08-15 and 1974-01-01 sorts as 1974).

name: users' favorites are listed as collections
why: fav-<user> collections are people's lists, counted in Favorites, not collections.

name: Favorites counted from the fav- collections instead of num_favorites
why: Known overlap, recorded honestly: in the 2026-10-31 capture num_favorites equals the fav- count on every row (probe-ia-search.py), so the fallback gives the same number and no spec can tell them apart.

edits.find: const favs = typeof d.num_favorites === 'number' ? d.num_favorites : colls.filter(c => c.startsWith('fav-')).length;

name: a full-text search gets the button
why: advancedsearch.php does not index what sin=TXT searches: the table would answer a different question.

name: an archive.org link on archive.org is 'not another site'
why: Our table's titles link the item on the same host; without the exception they get no card.

name: a track link asks its own request
why: keyUrl: a link to one file shares its show's request (vzell's answer Q10).

name: the linked track is not marked
why: Q10: the show's window with that track's row marked.

name: archive.org is not a known host
why: It is in the header's @connect: a hover may ask it, no 'not contacted yet' card.
grep: a show: the card on a hover

name: an item archive.org does not have is read as an item
why: The metadata API answers 200 {} for no item: a dead link, not an empty card.

name: archive.org's tiles follow YouTube's setting
why: Each source its own setting (sa_ia_play_in_place); the fixtures keep YouTube's off.
